text: 1 Wood log can be crafted into 4 planks in personal 2x2 grid without a table.
4 Planks craft 1 Crafting Table; 2 Planks craft 4 Sticks.
A Crafting Table unlocks 3x3 synthesis of wooden pickaxes, axes, and swords.
Night darkness spawns hostile skeletons and creepers; an enclosed shelter protects health.
Stone requires a wooden pickaxe to harvest; punching stone with bare hands yields no drops.
